articles.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
articles.description: On 18 November 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing five vulnerabilities in NGINX that allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code with the privileges of the NGINX worker process. While researchers managed to successfully demonstrate the use of CVE-2026-123007, no exploitation in the wild has been reported yet. It is recommended to swiftly update NGINX as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing appliances.
